Overview

llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (--moe-cache-mib, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism Bonsai 2 27B, EmbeddingGemma-2 (text+vision+audio), the LiquidAI d1/d1-omni and vLLM decision 2/d3 decision models, pplx-decider, MiniCPM-V 4.7, Nemotron Super 3.5 VL / Nemotron Bolt and maion-coder. entry.title: b11671: model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio) (#30616)
entry.content:
• model: add Muse Spark Open (text, vision and audio)

Muse Spark Open is a latent space MoE: the residual stream stays at 8192
while the 256 experts live in 4096, with a projection down and up around
them, top-8 sigmoid routing with a correction bias. Attention interleaves
three sliding layers at a 2048 window with rope for one global layer
without rope, with a sigmoid output gate and a weightless QK-norm.
Residuals are norm preserving, their gate is folded at conversion time.
